items.subject: Quote for AC installation
items.message: Hi, I need a quote for a 3-ton AC unit install in a 1,800 sq ft home. Can you send pricing and earliest availability?
items.suggestedResponse: Thanks for reaching out, Sarah. Our standard 3-ton AC install starts at $4,200 including labor and permits. I can schedule a free site visit this week — Tue or Thu afternoon work best on our end.

items.subject: Invoice #4821 — duplicate charge
items.message: I was charged twice for the same service visit on May 18. Invoice 4821 shows $285 twice on my card. Please refund the duplicate.
items.escalationReason: Duplicate charge over $200 — requires manager approval

items.subject: Thermostat not connecting
items.message: My smart thermostat keeps disconnecting from WiFi after your tech replaced the unit yesterday. Error code E47 on the display.
items.escalationReason: Post-install failure within 24h — dispatch senior tech

items.subject: Callback — maintenance plan renewal
items.message: Customer called about renewing annual maintenance plan. Wants to compare Gold vs Silver tier before deciding.
items.suggestedResponse: Gold plan ($29/mo) includes 2 tune-ups, priority scheduling, and 15% off repairs. Silver ($19/mo) covers 1 tune-up and standard scheduling. Happy to email a side-by-side comparison.

items.subject: Cancel service appointment
items.message: Please cancel my appointment for May 25. We sold the house and no longer need the duct cleaning.

items.subject: Are you open Memorial Day?
items.message: Are you open on Memorial Day Monday? Need emergency AC repair if possible.
items.suggestedResponse: We're closed Memorial Day for the holiday. Emergency line is available 24/7 for no-cool situations — dispatch fee applies. I can book you first slot Tuesday 8 AM.

items.subject: Refund for cancelled install
items.message:
I cancelled my install 3 weeks ago but still haven't received the $500 deposit back. Order ref #HL-2291.

--- follow-up ---
It's been three weeks — I still don't have the deposit. Please escalate.
items.escalationReason: Refund pending 21+ days — finance follow-up required

items.subject: Commercial HVAC maintenance quote
items.message: Looking for quarterly maintenance on two rooftop units for our retail location (~4,500 sq ft). Please send commercial pricing.

items.subject: Follow-up on filter delivery
items.message: Called to check status on MERV-13 filter order placed May 20. Customer needs confirmation before weekend.
items.suggestedResponse: Your filter order shipped May 22 via UPS — tracking #1Z999AA10123456784. Expected delivery May 24.

items.subject: Strange noise from furnace
items.message: Furnace making a loud banging noise when it kicks on. Started last night. Is this urgent?
items.suggestedResponse: Banging on startup often indicates delayed ignition or a loose panel — treat as urgent if you smell gas. We can send a tech today between 2–5 PM. Please confirm address on file.
